title: Fact
description: The trust-layer primitive — docs/API_CONTRACT.md §2 `Fact` (verbatim example reproduced in `fixtures/fact/01_valid_api_example.json`), persisted in infra/db/V1__init.sql `facts` (lines 537-553), governed by docs/AGENT_CONTRACT.md §4 (「any number a user can see must resolve to a Fact」) and §5 (freshness TTLs). Spec §19.

fact_id.description: API_CONTRACT §2 `fact_id`. V1 stores the same value in `facts.id` (line 538) — the platform layer maps `id -> fact_id` on serialisation (CONTRACT NOTES 7 in `src/enums.ts`).

subject_id.description: V1 `facts.subject_id` is NOT NULL: a fact is always about a row.

attribute.description: V1 `facts.attribute` is free text, so the schema only pins the snake_case form; `FACT_ATTRIBUTE` in `src/enums.ts` is the recommended registry (`price`, `opening_hours`, `availability`, `capacity`, `rating`, `inventory`, …).

value.description: API_CONTRACT §2 `value`. For prices it is a `Money` object (the §2 example). Anything JSON-serialisable is storable (V1 `value jsonb`), which is why the branches are enumerated instead of `true`.

confidence.description: V1 `numeric(4,3) DEFAULT 1.000`. AGENT_CONTRACT §4: never upgraded for presentation.

expires_at.description: AGENT_CONTRACT §5 TTLs are enforced by the conformance rule `fact_within_ttl` against `FRESHNESS_TTL_SECONDS` in `src/fact.ts`.

FactSource.title: FactSource
FactSource.description: API_CONTRACT §2 comment (`merchant|imported|observed|third_party|inferred`) = V1 `facts.source` priority order, AGENT_CONTRACT §4 (merchant > imported > observed > third-party > inferred).

OpeningState.title: OpeningState
OpeningState.description: API_CONTRACT §2 'Opening state (computed, never guessed)'. Derived from V1 `business_hours` (weekday 0=Mon..6=Sun, `crosses_midnight`) and cached at most 24h (AGENT_CONTRACT §5).

as_of.description: When the verdict was computed — AGENT_CONTRACT §5 forbids a cached answer reading as live.

AvailabilityStatus.title: AvailabilityStatus
AvailabilityStatus.description: API_CONTRACT §2 `availability.status`. `unknown` is a legal answer; fabricating a slot is not (DECISIONS D6, spec §20).

AvailabilityInfo.title: AvailabilityInfo
AvailabilityInfo.description: API_CONTRACT §2 `EntityCard.availability` = `{status, next_slot}`. Real-time only: AGENT_CONTRACT §5 sets TTL 0 and API_CONTRACT §4 marks the endpoint `no-store`.

MatchExplanation.title: MatchExplanation
MatchExplanation.description: API_CONTRACT §2 `MatchExplanation` — 「every bullet must trace to a fact id」 (spec §18). The traceability check is the conformance rule `entity_card_explanation_traceable`.

label.description: Machine label for styling/i18n, e.g. `within_budget`. `EXPLANATION_LABEL` in `src/enums.ts` is the recommended registry.

fact_id.description: `null` is representable but not renderable: AGENT_CONTRACT §4's renderer contract drops the bullet.

AiMatchInfo.title: AiMatchInfo
AiMatchInfo.description: API_CONTRACT §2 `EntityCard.ai_match` = `{score, reasons[]}`. Sponsored placement is a separate flag and never feeds `score` (AGENT_CONTRACT §6, spec §67).

FactRef.title: FactRef
FactRef.description: Citation pointer embedded in recommendation items so a client can re-resolve a claim without shipping the whole fact.
